# AK GC Top 10 — Would Not Benefit (Board design+mobile refine)

**Audience:** Board / Rainmaker
**Set:** Site Scout `would_not_benefit` only (**141** rows; was **144** content-only; was 105 at prior refresh)
**Gold standard:** https://farnorthgc.com
**Date:** 2026-09-15 ~21:48 AKDT (America/Anchorage)
**Refresh driver:** Board scoring refine — **A Visual design + B Mobile UX are HARD GATES**. Content checklist alone invalid. Scout flipped 3 design/mobile fails out of WNB. Top10 rebuilt from current WNB only.

## TLDR

- Board spot-check: prior #1 **Wheeler** (wheelergeneral.com) is D–F design + terrible mobile → not a Far North-class peer. Content-signal rubric was wrong.
- Scout reclass (`DESIGN_MOBILE_RECLASS.md`): **Wheeler / Alaska ITS / AAA Fence** → `could_benefit` (`design_mobile_fail`). WNB **144 → 141**.
- New Top10 = **9 Scout A/B-confirmed prior peers** (Wheeler removed) + **#10 Florcraft** (Scout explicit non-flip: live mobile OK; remodel-adjacent flooring). Better honest peers than checklist ghosts.
- **RAD** (`radgeneral.com`, 251132) left WNB and is Board’s own client — **not ranked** as a competitor peer (noted only).
- **Card ≠ GO.** No outreach until Board asks.
